transcripts.transcript: The shuttle carried large numbers of students when the temporary residence opened in September. During the spring term, however, most residents moved into accommodation within walking distance of campus. Passenger numbers then fell sharply, even though the timetable had not changed. The transport office therefore plans to review demand before reducing the service.
transcripts.target_signal: 把变化发生的时间与原因对应
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The first experiment finished on schedule at the end of May. The team expected to begin the next stage immediately, but a replacement sensor arrived a week late. No data had been lost, and funding was still available. The delay resulted from waiting for the part, rather than repeating the earlier experiment.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分原安排与因故调整
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The booking system was introduced in January, but staff spent the first month learning to use it. Waiting times did not begin to fall until February, when duplicate reservations were identified and removed. The office cautions that the initial training period should not be treated as evidence that the system had no value.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别一项措施实施后的结果与范围
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Applications rose after the university launched its publicity campaign in March. However, a new scholarship scheme was announced at almost the same time. The research team says the timing alone cannot show how much of the increase came from publicity, because the two changes may have influenced applicants together.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分时间先后与唯一因果
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The laboratory had remained open throughout the examination period, despite relatively low use. It closed for two weeks in July so that the ventilation system could be replaced. Staff chose that period because most research teams were away, reducing the disruption. Low usage itself was not the reason for a permanent closure.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别停用设施的直接原因
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The damaged parts were replaced on Monday, but the equipment could not be used until a safety test had been completed. That test took place on Wednesday afternoon, and the room reopened on Thursday. The extra interval was needed for verification, not because another breakdown had occurred.
transcripts.target_signal: 把恢复时间与完成条件连接
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The Harbour Line opened in eighteen ninety-six. At first, its trains were pulled by a cable system. Electric trains replaced that system in nineteen thirty-five, although the original circular route remained in use.
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Use of the Harbour Line fell when many factories closed. Passenger numbers began to recover after a new university campus opened nearby. By two thousand and five, the line carried more than twelve million journeys a year.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析时间因果的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: During the planning review, some officials proposed replacing the circular route with a straight line. Local residents objected because several neighbourhoods would lose their stations. The final plan retained the circle and improved the existing stops.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析时间因果的含义与适用条件

transcripts.transcript: The line struggled financially in its first decade. Construction costs had been higher than expected, while fewer people used the trains than the planners had forecast. A later connection to the main railway brought more passengers.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析时间因果的含义与适用条件

transcripts.transcript: The modernisation programme replaced the old trains and improved station entrances. However, it added no new routes. Critics welcomed the more reliable service but argued that residents in the outer districts still had poor access to it.

transcripts.transcript: The operator began testing an automatic control system last year. During the trial, staff remained on every train. A decision about fully unattended operation will be made only after the safety assessment and public consultation are complete.
